rule_title: TTP 1021.002 - PsExec Remote Execution via SMB Admin Share
description: Detects PsExec remote execution via its actual event sequence: PSEXESVC.exe written to ADMIN$, followed by the PSEXESVC service being installed (EID 4697), and the PSEXESVC named pipe opened on IPC$. The stdin/stdout/stderr pipe creation is the final confirmation of an active interactive session. Note: the svcctl named pipe pattern belongs to Impacket services.py, not PsExec.

steps.description: PSEXESVC named pipe opened on IPC$ — interactive session established
